changelog: Aura AI v2.4.9 — Startup Crash Fix, WhatsApp Auto-Reply (#18) & Fresh Chat Context Isolation
Reverted experimental Image Generation UI redesign back to stable v2.4.7 chat composer & viewer UI while keeping core Voice, Device Control, Browser MCP, and YouTube improvements
Preserved #18 WhatsApp Notification Auto-Reply (Smart Confirm default + Direct Auto-Reply toggle via AuraNotificationListenerService and quick notification confirm/dismiss actions)
Preserved Fresh New Chat Context Isolation (prevents stale project context from leaking into new chats)
Added resilient startup initialization guards and built-in CrashLogger diagnostics (Downloads/AuraAI_last_crash.txt)
